Multi-Facet Structured Coding Engine

Schemas, crossed experimental coding designs, resumable checkpointing, integrity-checked caches, and pluggable backends.

Define a Field for an LLM Coding Schema
coding_schema()

as_json_schema()
Convert a Coding Schema to a JSON Schema List
validate_coded_output()
Validate and Parse Structured LLM Output Against a Coding Schema
coding_cache()
Create a Content-Addressed Response Cache for LLM Coding
cache_key()
Compute Content-Addressed SHA-256 Cache Key
cache_get() cache_set() cache_clear() cache_stats()
Retrieve, Store, Clear, or Inspect a Coding Cache

code_texts()
Execute a Multi-Facet Structured LLM Coding Design

LLM Psychometrics & Generalizability

Generalizability Theory variance decomposition, Decision Studies, calibration against human gold standards, human ceilings, and drift monitoring.

g_study()
Generalizability Study (G-Study) for Multi-Facet LLM Coding
d_study()
Decision Study (D-Study) Reliability Projections & Optimal Design Solver
calibration_metrics()
Calibration Metrics Comparing LLM Scores to Human Gold Standards
human_irr()
Human Inter-Rater Reliability (IRR) Ceiling Benchmark
check_drift()
Test for Temporal or Model-Version Scoring Drift

Differential Prompt Functioning & Fairness

Uniform and non-uniform subgroup measurement invariance testing and prompt-level FDR screening.

dpf_test()
Differential Prompt Functioning (DPF) & Measurement Invariance Test

Prediction-Powered Inference & Multilevel Extensions

Error-corrected estimators combining human validation subsets with large LLM-coded corpora, including Horvitz-Thompson active IPW-PPI and cross-fitted non-linear calibration.

ppi_mean()
Prediction-Powered Mean Estimation (PPI / PPI++ / Active IPW-PPI)
ppi_proportion()
Prediction-Powered Category Proportion & Prevalence Estimation (PPI / PPI++)
ppi_lm()
Prediction-Powered Linear Regression (PPI / PPI++ / Calibrated Control Variate)
ppi_glm()
Prediction-Powered Generalized Linear Model (PPI / PPI++ / Calibrated)
ppi_calibrated()
Cross-Fitted Non-Linear Calibration for Prediction-Powered Inference
ppi_clustered()
Cluster-Robust Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI / PPI++)
ppi_lmer()
Multilevel Random-Intercept Prediction-Powered Inference (ppi_lmer)
